query: Database RLS and SCADA telemetry design

stage1_proposals.proposalText:
Architectural Perspective for "Database RLS and SCADA telemetry design":
- Structure modular domain boundaries between UI and data-access.
- Model canonical schemas strictly in @repo/contract.
- Maintain single source of truth and avoid cross-layer leakage.

Security Analysis for "Database RLS and SCADA telemetry design":
- Enforce PostgreSQL RLS assertions on all underlying entities.
- Sanitize all external inputs via Zod contracts prior to mutation.
- Audit employee authorization and hardware scanner session tokens.

Operational & Resilience Analysis for "Database RLS and SCADA telemetry design":
- Implement robust hardware reconnection backoff with jitter.
- Buffer peripheral commands in local offline queue with retry caps.
- Provide structured logging and status heartbeats.

Verification & QA Strategy for "Database RLS and SCADA telemetry design":
- Formulate test cases in strict EARS syntax (WHEN ... THE SYSTEM SHALL ...).
- Provide isolated unit tests with mock device boundaries.
- Assert zero UI regressions and light-mode invariant compliance (#f3f4f6).

stage3_synthesis.query: Database RLS and SCADA telemetry design
consensusPoints: Universal agreement on enforcing strict boundary checks and Zod schemas (@repo/contract).
Consensus that PostgreSQL RLS policies must govern data mutations.
Agreement that device/hardware communication requires offline fallback and retry jitter.
Adherence to light-mode (#f3f4f6) UI and EARS verification test patterns.
dissentingViews: Security Auditor recommended hard error aborts on unauthenticated scanner events, whereas Operations advocated soft buffering.
stage3_synthesis.finalVerdict: ADOPT COMBINED SPECIFICATION: Prioritize the structural approach of Candidate A (Principal Systems Architect, Score: 9.3/10), incorporating the security boundaries from Candidate B and hardware resilience protocols from Candidate C.
actionItems: 1. Create EARS test suite covering both offline buffering and strict RLS validation.
2. Expose canonical Zod schemas in packages/contract/src/schemas/.
3. Enforce light-mode invariant and UI OKLCH design tokens.
